Create a Salary Rule

User manual · English · 12 steps
Learn how to add a new salary rule, such as a fixed allowance, to a salary structure: name it, give it a category and a code, attach it to a structure, set the amount and save it.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Rules

Click Rules.

4. New rule

Click New to create a salary rule.

5. Rule name

Type the name of the rule, then press Tab.

6. Category

Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

ℹ️ Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

7. Choose the category

Click the result you want in the list.

8. Code

Type a short code for the rule, then press Tab.

9. Structure

Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

ℹ️ Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

10. Choose the structure

Click the result you want in the list.

11. Fixed amount

Type the fixed amount, then press Tab.

12. Save

Click the save icon to keep the rule.
